Scientific boundary

What this MVP can and cannot answer

The Gassum view uses 405 successful OPM Flow 2026.04 CO2STORE simulations: nine property realizations, three shared all-fault transmissibilities, Alpha/Beta/Zeta unit responses, and five explicit injection-and-shut-in schedules. The 1–3 Mt/yr project controls use transparent unit-response superposition for regional screening.

All 29 supplied fault traces are represented as one vertical transmissibility set through the six Gassum layers. Storage Alpha, Beta and Zeta are screening placements rather than optimized or permit-ready well locations; Zeta is fixed at model Cell 192.

The OPM ensemble uses the mapped Gassum–Vinding structure, a well-calibrated sand porosity depth trend, the observed porosity–permeability transform, and spatial net-to-gross. It remains a regional screening model rather than a history-matched or permitting model. Decisions require calibrated fluids, fault properties, coupled geomechanics, operational constraints, monitoring data, and qualified reservoir and geomechanics review.

OPM model disclosure

Model assumptions & provenance

These are the actual inputs used for the published Gassum screening ensemble. Values are deliberately visible so results can be reproduced and challenged.

Geological screening model—not calibrated.The OPM grid now uses the same mapped Gassum structure and spatial petrophysics shown in the explorer. The configured pressure limit is still not a calibrated fracture or seismicity threshold.
